claims.statement: After the naval victory at Arginusae in 406 BCE, Athens prosecuted the commanders over the failure to recover men and bodies from the sea. Socrates opposed the unlawful collective proceedings. Six generals were executed.
Acropolis reference for Athens, not the exact event location
